info.name: Google Cloud Artifact Registry Projects API
info.description:
The Artifact Registry API provides programmatic access to create and manage repositories, upload and download artifacts, manage packages and versions, and configure IAM policies for artifact storage across multiple formats including Docker images, language packages, and OS packages.

Contact Support:
 Name: Google Cloud

item.name: Google Cloud Artifact Registry List Packages
Google Cloud Artifact Registry List Docker Images

request.description: Lists Docker images in a repository.

item.name: Google Cloud Artifact Registry Get Repository
Google Cloud Artifact Registry Update Repository
Google Cloud Artifact Registry Delete Repository

request.description: Deletes a repository and all of its contents.

item.name: Google Cloud Artifact Registry List Repositories

request.description: Lists repositories in a given project and location.

item.name: Google Cloud Artifact Registry Create Repository

request.description: Creates a new repository in the specified project and location.

item.name: Google Cloud Artifact Registry List Locations

request.description: Lists available locations for the specified project.
